projects.name: Upsert® Advanced Formulas
projects.description: Upsert® Advanced Formulas extends SugarLogic with additional formulas for aggregations, conditionals, dates, and boolean operations. It includes optimized versions of core SugarAI functions plus custom functions that cover calculations that standard SugarLogic does not support. The formulas are designed for complex calculations across large datasets. Advanced Formulas is included at no extra cost when you purchase Calculated Fields.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that adds performance-optimized SugarLogic functions and custom formulas for aggregations, conditionals, dates, and boolean logic.

projects.name: Upsert® Assist
projects.description: Upsert® Assist connects Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to SugarAI so you can generate record summaries, update fields, draft emails, and identify action items without leaving the CRM. In-app prompts run against record-scoped context so the model only uses the data that is relevant to the task. You can also query CRM data from the native Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini interfaces through MCP. Admins choose which LLM providers and capabilities each team can use.
projects.shortDescription: Brings Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini into SugarAI for record summaries, field updates, email drafts, action items, and MCP access.

projects.name: Upsert® BPM Essentials
projects.description: Upsert® BPM Essentials adds SugarBPM process actions that update fields, including read-only fields, write comment log entries, and route records with preferred-agent logic based on Shifts and Shift Exceptions. It also adds admin dashlets for record process management, related SugarBPM assets, and triggered processes. The goal is to put more no-code workflow controls in the hands of Sugar administrators.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that adds SugarBPM process actions and admin dashlets for field updates, comment logs, preferred-agent routing, and process visibility.

projects.name: Upsert® Calculated Fields
projects.description: Upsert® Calculated Fields monitors changes that affect SugarLogic formulas and recalculates those fields on the backend so values stay current without a performance hit. It can keep time-based formulas such as daysUntil and hoursUntil up to date, and you can limit recalculation to selected records in a module. This supports calculated-field behavior that standard SugarLogic alone does not support at scale.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that keeps SugarLogic calculated fields current in near real time without slowing the CRM.

projects.name: Upsert® Calendar
projects.description: Upsert® Calendar provides shared calendar and shift-schedule views for Sugar calls, meetings, and tasks, plus custom event modules. You can select the users, teams, or roles whose events appear in a collaborative view. Use it to coordinate availability, manage shifts, and plan meetings from one place in Sugar.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that shows shared calendars and shift schedules for native activities and custom event modules.

projects.name: Upsert® Connector for Fireflies.ai
projects.description: Upsert® Connector for Fireflies.ai imports meeting and call transcriptions, summaries, and action items from Fireflies.ai into SugarAI. The connector links each conversation to the matching activity and parent records, and surfaces follow-ups where you work. That keeps meeting intelligence in the CRM without manual copy and paste.
projects.shortDescription: Imports Fireflies.ai transcriptions, summaries, and action items into SugarAI and links them to the matching records.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage
projects.description: Upsert® Engage connects SugarAI to CTI systems that support browser screen pop, including Avaya, Asterisk, and 3CX. It creates call records automatically, relates them to the matching people and accounts, and shows caller insights such as line type, location, and time zone before you dial. Call Sheets help you organize and run outbound call lists for campaigns and follow-ups.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that connects to CTI systems that support browser screen pop, with automatic call logging and caller insights.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage for Dialpad
projects.description: Upsert® Engage for Dialpad embeds Dialpad call controls in the Sugar UI so you can make and receive calls without the Dialpad desktop app. You can open Dialpad call history, text, fax, and voicemail from Sugar, update your Dialpad status, and save recording URLs on the Sugar call record. The add-on creates call records, relates them to the matching person and account, logs duration, and shows phone-number insights before you dial.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that embeds Dialpad calling with automatic call logging, caller insights, and in-app call history.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage for RingCentral
projects.description: Upsert® Engage for RingCentral embeds RingCentral call controls in the Sugar UI so you can make and receive calls without the RingCentral desktop app. You can open RingCentral call history, text, fax, and voicemail from Sugar, update your status, and save recording URLs on the Sugar call record. The add-on creates call records, relates them to the matching person and account, logs duration, and includes Call Sheets for outbound campaigns.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that embeds RingCentral calling with automatic call logging, caller insights, and Call Sheets.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage for WhatsApp
projects.description: Upsert® Engage for WhatsApp brings WhatsApp Business conversations into SugarAI through Message Center. You can send and receive messages, apply templates, match customers to records, and keep full conversation history on the CRM record. Voice calling is available as an add-on.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that brings WhatsApp Business messaging into Message Center with conversation logging, templates, and optional voice calling.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage for Zoom Phone
projects.description: Upsert® Engage for Zoom Phone embeds Zoom Phone in SugarAI so you can dial from records, send SMS, and log calls automatically. It also captures AI summaries, transcripts, and action items, and supports outbound call lists. That keeps phone and SMS context on the CRM record for automation and reporting.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that embeds Zoom Phone for dial-from-record, SMS, automatic call logging, AI summaries, and outbound call lists.

projects.name: Upsert® Deduplicate
projects.description: Upsert® Deduplicate detects duplicate records with custom match rules, domain matching, and fuzzy matching that includes Soundex. You can define unlimited match conditions for stock and custom modules, review merge suggestions in a record view dashlet, and keep a merge history per record or across the system. When you sync records from other applications, you can prioritize those source records so Sugar stays aligned with integrated systems. Cross Module Detection and File Deduplication are available as paid options.
projects.shortDescription: Detects and merges duplicate SugarAI records with custom match rules, fuzzy matching, and conflict resolution.

projects.name: Upsert® Focused Views
projects.description: Upsert® Focused Views lets administrators choose which subpanels and dashlets appear on each record view tab. When you select a tab, Sugar shows only the related lists and intelligence pane content that you configured for that user, team, or role. For example, you can create a Marketing tab with Leads and Campaigns, an Accounting tab with Quotes and Contracts, or a Sales tab with opportunities and subscriptions.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that lets admins assign specific subpanels and dashlets to record view tabs for users, teams, or roles.

projects.name: Upsert® IP Restriction Manager
projects.description: Upsert® IP Restriction Manager lets administrators limit which IP addresses and platforms can access Sugar, by user, team, or role. Even with valid credentials, access from an unauthorized network can be blocked. The add-on is free and open source. Support packages are available for advanced configurations.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that lets admins limit access by IP address and platform for users, teams, or roles. Open source.

projects.name: Upsert® Last Modified By
projects.description: Upsert® Last Modified By displays who changed an audited field and when, as a label under the field on the record view. You do not need to open the Audit Log for that at-a-glance detail. Admins enable the stamp on any audited field in stock or custom modules from the Last Modified By admin page.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that shows who last changed an audited field, and when, directly under the field without opening the Audit Log.

projects.name: Upsert® LaunchPad
projects.description: Upsert® LaunchPad lets administrators add always-available links to the Sugar navigation bar. You can show each category and menu item to all users or only to specific teams or roles, drag and drop the order, assign icons, and define language translations for each element.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that lets admins add always-available navigation links that can be scoped by team or role and localized.

projects.name: Upsert® Lens
projects.description: Upsert® Lens gives administrators dashlets and tools for backend Sugar processes that were previously hard to inspect without a developer. You can monitor the full-text search queue, job queue, tracker, geocoding, upgrade history, user activity, and plugin installs from one place.
projects.shortDescription: Gives admins visibility into queues, trackers, plugin installs, and other backend SugarAI processes.

projects.name: Upsert® Lockout
projects.description: Upsert® Lockout restricts administrator and developer-level actions outside designated maintenance windows. Admins with Lockout access can create standalone or recurring windows. Locked-out admins see upcoming access windows when they try a restricted action. Selected administrators can bypass lockouts for emergencies.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that restricts admin changes outside designated maintenance windows to protect production stability.

projects.name: Upsert® Connector for Loqate
projects.description: Upsert® Connector for Loqate validates addresses, phone numbers, and emails in SugarAI through Loqate. You get as-you-type address lookup, autocomplete, batch validation across 250 countries and territories, geocoding to latitude and longitude, and checks against international address standards.
projects.shortDescription: Validates and standardizes addresses, phones, and emails in SugarAI with Loqate, including autocomplete and geocoding.

projects.name: Upsert® Markdown Field
projects.description: Upsert® Markdown Field adds a Studio field type that accepts and renders Markdown. Supported formatting includes bold, italics, strikethrough, headings, lists, links, block quotes, tables, inline code, and code blocks. Admins can add Markdown fields to any stock or custom module.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that adds a Studio field type for Markdown, including agendas, checklists, and guides.

projects.name: Upsert® Masked Textfield
projects.description: Upsert® Masked Textfield adds a Studio field type that hides sensitive values such as social security numbers until you reveal them. Authorized users can select the view control to show the value, or copy it to the clipboard without displaying it. Admins can create as many masked text fields as needed in Studio.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that adds a Studio field type that hides sensitive values until an authorized user reveals or copies them.

projects.name: Upsert® Engage for Microsoft Teams
projects.description: Upsert® Engage for Microsoft Teams lets you send Teams messages from Sugar records, preload a record link, relate channels to records, read channel discussions in a dashlet, and automate Teams alerts with SugarBPM. Upsert® Engage for Microsoft Teams Phone is an optional add-on for making and receiving calls with automatic logging and caller insights.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that sends Microsoft Teams messages from records, with optional Teams Phone for logged calls and caller insights.

projects.name: Upsert® Migrator
projects.description: Upsert® Migrator is a development framework for schema changes, data updates, and promotions across SugarAI environments. You generate migration files for table creation, column changes, indexes, and data transforms, then run them consistently through upgrades and environment refreshes.
projects.shortDescription: Provides a framework for schema changes, data updates, and environment promotions across SugarAI instances.

projects.name: Upsert® Notifications
projects.description: Upsert® Notifications delivers event-driven alerts, business updates, maintenance notices, and file attachments through email, popup, or the notification center. Each notification tracks read or unread status so you can see who opened it. Use it for escalations, SLA breaches, company announcements, and shared documents.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that sends targeted alerts, updates, and file attachments through email, popup, or the notification center.

projects.name: Upsert® Preference Enforcer
projects.description: Upsert® Preference Enforcer lets administrators assign and enforce user preferences before people log in. You can set module tab layouts, themes, label placement, and locale settings for individual users, teams, or roles so onboarding starts with the correct workspace configuration.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that lets admins assign and enforce profile options, layouts, and themes for users, teams, or roles.

projects.name: Upsert® Connector for Shopify
projects.description: Upsert® Connector for Shopify syncs companies, customers, orders, products, subscriptions, and locations from Shopify into SugarAI. You can connect multiple stores, map fields per store, and keep relationships and multi-location inventory data aligned in the CRM.
projects.shortDescription: Syncs Shopify customers, orders, products, subscriptions, and locations into SugarAI across one or more stores.

projects.name: Upsert® Connector for Slack
projects.description: Upsert® Connector for Slack lets you send Slack messages from any Sugar record action menu, with a record link preloaded in the message. Admins can trigger automated Slack messages from SugarBPM when conditions are met. Users can also search Sugar from Slack with custom commands.
projects.shortDescription: Sends Slack messages from SugarAI records, supports SugarBPM alerts, and adds Slack search commands.

projects.name: Upsert® Sudo
projects.description: Upsert® Sudo lets administrators and designated users, teams, or roles impersonate other users without sharing passwords. Use it to reproduce issues in the same environment as the person who reported them, and to set up dashboards and preferences for new users. It works with SugarIdentity.
projects.shortDescription: Lets admins and designated users impersonate other users for support, troubleshooting, and setup. Works with SugarIdentity.

projects.name: Upsert® Connector for Swagger
projects.description: Upsert® Connector for Swagger exports SugarAI API endpoint documentation into Swagger so your API specs stay accurate after upgrades and customizations. You can subscribe to the export endpoint for ongoing updates. The connector ships a stock Swagger export and is available as open source under the Apache 2.0 license.
projects.shortDescription: Exports SugarAI API endpoint documentation into Swagger and can keep specs current through a subscription endpoint.

projects.name: Upsert® Themes
projects.description: Upsert® Themes lets you reskin Sugar with brand colors for the navigation bar, borders, buttons, and link text. You can also define alternate palettes and watermarks for cloned environments so sandboxes and production are easy to tell apart. Environment settings are defined in the base production instance and carry over when you refresh sandboxes.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that applies brand colors and environment watermarks so sandboxes and production are easy to tell apart.

projects.name: Upsert® Timesheets
projects.description: Upsert® Timesheets lets you log time against any Sugar record. It includes a stopwatch widget, time validation, round intervals, SugarBPM approvals, and reporting so you can measure effort on deals, projects, and support work.
projects.shortDescription: SugarAI add-on that tracks billable and non-billable time against any record, with validation, approvals, and reporting.

projects.name: Upsert® Trash Bin
projects.description: Upsert® Trash Bin lists deleted records for enabled modules and restores them along with relationships. You can limit visibility by team or role. Post-mortem installation is supported when you need emergency recovery after records were already deleted.
projects.shortDescription: Lists deleted SugarAI records and restores them, including related records, with team and role visibility controls.

projects.name: Upsert® User Adoption
projects.description: Upsert® User Adoption monitors creates, reads, updates, and deletes across Sugar modules and presents adoption insights in analytics dashlets and reports. Use it to see which people and teams are active in which modules.
projects.shortDescription: Tracks creates, reads, updates, and deletes across SugarAI modules to report on adoption patterns.

projects.name: IP Restriction Manager
projects.description: Open-source security solution allowing SugarCRM administrators to setup restrictive IP ranges for authentication. These ranges can be specific to a user, team, role or combination of all three. IP ranges can be specified in multiple formats including specific IPs, wildcards, CIDR notation, and start-end ranges. The plugin supports multiple platforms (Base, Mobile, All) and provides comprehensive security controls. Even if a hacker is able to steal a user's credentials, with the IP restriction manager, you can block users from accessing your system based on their location - even if they have the correct credentials. This provides an additional layer of security for your SugarCRM instance. The plugin is completely free and open source, licensed under Apache 2.0.
projects.shortDescription: Open-source security solution allowing administrators to limit IP addresses and platforms for Sugar access.

projects.name: Sugar Field Work Log
projects.description: Custom SugarCRM field type for tracking work logs and time entries. Provides enhanced functionality for logging work activities, time tracking, and work-related data within SugarCRM records. The plugin extends SugarCRM's field capabilities with a specialized work log field type that can be used across modules to track work activities, time spent, and related work information. This field type integrates seamlessly with SugarCRM's Studio, allowing administrators to add work log fields to any stock or custom module.
projects.shortDescription: Custom SugarCRM field type for tracking work logs and time entries across modules.

projects.name: Sugar Repairs Module
projects.description: Administrative module for SugarCRM that provides repair and maintenance functionality. This module enables administrators to perform system repairs, maintenance tasks, and diagnostic operations within the SugarCRM interface. The Repairs Module offers comprehensive tools for maintaining SugarCRM instance health, performing database repairs, clearing caches, rebuilding relationships, and executing other critical maintenance operations. It provides a centralized interface for common administrative tasks that would otherwise require command-line access or manual database operations. This project is deprecated as we were able to get the worklog field concept merged into the core SugarCRM product as the comment log
projects.shortDescription: Administrative module providing repair and maintenance functionality for SugarCRM instances.

projects.name: Sugar Instance Packager
projects.description: Development and deployment tool for packaging SugarCRM instances for migration, backup, or deployment purposes. The Instance Packager allows administrators and developers to create complete packages of SugarCRM instances including customizations, modules, configurations, and data. This tool streamlines the process of moving SugarCRM instances between environments, creating backups, and deploying customizations. It provides comprehensive packaging capabilities that ensure all custom code, configurations, and data are properly captured and can be reliably deployed to other environments.
projects.shortDescription: Development tool for packaging SugarCRM instances for migration, backup, or deployment.

projects.name: SugarCRM Portal
projects.description: Designed, developed, and integrated an internal SugarCRM instance with a custom customer-facing SugarCRM instance. This comprehensive portal solution enables customers to communicate directly with SugarCRM support teams to get assistance and view their data usage information. The integration seamlessly connects internal support operations with customer-facing interfaces, providing a unified experience for customer service and support interactions. The portal includes custom modules, workflows, and integrations that allow customers to access their account information, submit support requests, track ticket status, and monitor their SugarCRM instance usage metrics. This solution streamlines customer support operations while providing customers with self-service capabilities and transparent access to their account data.
projects.shortDescription: Custom customer-facing portal integrated with internal SugarCRM for support communication and data usage viewing.

projects.name: SugarCRM Support Site
projects.description: Designed and implemented a comprehensive Content Management System (CMS) for the internal knowledge team to write and publish content to the SugarCRM support site. This system automated critical content management processes including versioning, editioning, and in some cases, content for developer documentation. The CMS streamlines the content creation and publishing workflow, enabling the knowledge team to efficiently manage documentation, support articles, and technical content. The system includes automated version control for documentation, edition-specific content management, and sophisticated content generation capabilities that can automatically create complex content. This solution significantly improved the efficiency of content creation and maintenance while ensuring consistency and accuracy across all published materials.
projects.shortDescription: CMS designed and implemented for internal knowledge team to write and publish content.

projects.name: SugarCRM Support Tooling
projects.description: Designed and implemented comprehensive customizations for the Sugar Support team to help them interact with customers and manage their case load more effectively. This suite of internal tools included a revolutionary Support Dashboard that provided support agents with a unified view of customer interactions, case management, and workflow optimization. The Support Dashboard featured innovative design patterns and user experience concepts that later became the inspiration for the Sales and Service Console views found in SugarCRM Today. The tooling solution streamlined support operations by providing agents with quick access to customer history, case details, related records, and actionable insights. The system improved case resolution times, enhanced customer satisfaction, and established new paradigms for console-based CRM interfaces that would influence the future direction of SugarCRM's product development.
projects.shortDescription: Customizations for Sugar Support team including a Support Dashboard that inspired Sales and Service Console views in SugarCRM Today.

projects.name: SugarCRM Developer Certification
projects.description: Contributed to the development and writing of the SugarCRM Developer Certification test in 2015. This comprehensive certification examination was designed to validate developers' knowledge and expertise in SugarCRM platform development, including customizations, module development, API usage, and best practices. The certification test covered critical areas such as SugarCRM architecture, data relationships, workflow automation, custom modules, API integration, and security considerations. This certification program helped establish industry standards for SugarCRM development expertise and provided developers with a recognized credential to demonstrate their proficiency in the platform.
projects.shortDescription: Contributed to writing the SugarCRM Developer Certification test, establishing industry standards for SugarCRM development expertise.

projects.name: Dashboard Manager
projects.description: Developed a SugarCRM 6.x module loadable plugin that allows system administrators to set up and manage dashboard templates. This module provides administrators with the ability to create standardized dashboard configurations and push them to users, ensuring consistent dashboard layouts across teams and improving onboarding efficiency. The Dashboard Manager module simplifies the process of dashboard deployment and maintenance, allowing administrators to define template dashboards with specific dashlet configurations and apply them to individual users or groups. The module was published on SugarForge and has been used by the SugarCRM community to streamline dashboard management in enterprise deployments.
projects.shortDescription: SugarCRM 6.x module for managing and pushing user dashboards, allowing administrators to create and deploy dashboard templates.

projects.name: SugarCRM Developer Guide
projects.description: Wrote and maintained the comprehensive SugarCRM Developer Guide from 2011 to 2019, serving as the primary technical documentation resource for SugarCRM developers worldwide. This extensive documentation covered all aspects of SugarCRM development, including platform architecture, module development, API usage, customization techniques, best practices, and advanced development topics. The Developer Guide provided developers with the knowledge and examples needed to build custom solutions, integrate third-party systems, and extend SugarCRM functionality. As the primary maintainer, I was responsible for keeping the documentation current with each platform release, ensuring accuracy, and expanding coverage to include new features and capabilities. This documentation became an essential resource for the SugarCRM developer community and continues to be referenced by developers building solutions on the platform.
projects.shortDescription: Wrote and maintained the SugarCRM Developer Guide, serving as the primary technical documentation resource for developers.

projects.name: Integrating Lead Capture Forms with SugarCRM
projects.description: Published a comprehensive technical guide on integrating lead capture forms with SugarAI, covering multiple integration options to accommodate various business needs. The blog post details four different approaches: the unauthenticated REST endpoint POST /rest/v10/Leads/register, the WebToLeadCapture entry point, authenticated REST API endpoints, and custom endpoint solutions. The article provides developers with practical examples and best practices for implementing lead capture functionality, helping businesses streamline their lead generation process and improve data quality. The guide includes downloadable Postman collections to help developers get started quickly with their implementations.
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive technical guide on integrating lead capture forms with SugarAI.

projects.name: The SugarCRM Upsert API as Explained by Upsert
projects.description: Authored an in-depth technical blog post explaining the SugarAI upsert API endpoints introduced in SugarAI 10.2.0. The article provides a comprehensive guide to understanding and implementing upsert functionality, which combines update and insert operations into a single API call. The blog covers how to populate sync keys, fetch records by sync field, perform upsert operations, and delete records using the new integrate endpoints. The guide helps developers reduce API requests, simplify integration code, improve performance, and prevent duplicate record creation. The article includes practical examples, request/response formats, and downloadable Postman environment and collection files to help developers quickly implement upsert functionality in their integrations. This article was also published on SugarClub at [SugarClub Dev Blog](https://sugarclub.sugarcrm.com/dev-club/b/dev-blog/posts/upsert-explained-by-upsert).
projects.shortDescription: In-depth guide to the SugarAI upsert API endpoints.

projects.name: How to Build Custom Record Views in Sugar
projects.description: Created a detailed technical tutorial on building custom record views and routes in SugarAI, published as a Halloween-themed "coder treat" for developers. The comprehensive guide walks through creating custom views for record creation, viewing, and editing, along with layouts and routes to create clean, custom URLs. The article provides step-by-step instructions for creating limited field views that work separately from stock record views, including code examples for view files, metadata definitions, layout configurations, and routing setup. The tutorial helps developers create custom data entry interfaces for teams that need simplified views without the complexity of full record layouts, and includes downloadable code examples for Sugar 9.0.0 Professional.
projects.shortDescription: Detailed tutorial on building custom record views, layouts, and routes in SugarAI to create simplified data entry interfaces.
